instruction: Modify VS Code's file save settings to enable auto-save functionality when the editor window loses focus.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to enable auto-save when focus changes by setting files.autoSave to 'onFocusChange'. This is a common productivity setting similar in difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: fetches /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json which is the standard VS Code user settings location on Linux
Metric comparison logic is correct: check_json_settings properly parses JSON and checks for exact key-value matches using appropriate sentinel pattern to distinguish missing keys from None values
Expected value is semantically correct: files.autoSave = onFocusChange is the exact VS Code setting required for auto-save on focus change
Coverage is complete: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement
Data flow is correct: getter fetches file → metric parses JSON → metric checks specific key-value pair
Edge cases are properly handled: returns 0.0 for file retrieval failures, JSON parsing errors, and missing keys
State accessibility is good: settings.json persists on disk and doesn't require UI to be open, no postconfig needed

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
